scientific_integrity: The universal operator classification is proved analytically. Finite diagnostic code is supplementary, and no independent mathematical audit or validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to normalized-duality self-adjointness on real or complex ell_p(I), with at least two coordinates, 1<p<infinity, and p != 2. Does not classify general L_p spaces or weaker Hermitian notions. A 2020 foundational article was accessible only as an abstract, leaving priority risk.
title: Scaled-involution rigidity for duality-self-adjoint operators on \(\ell_p\)
